purpose: Select one quality-first single-Agent profile for Canonical-50; this development comparison is not the public benchmark headline.

candidates.rationale: quality-oriented coding model available through the OpenCode Go subscription
strong current Chat-Completions coding model available through the same OpenCode Go subscription

fixed_runtime.billing_boundary: OpenCode Go subscription only; no separately funded DeepSeek endpoint
fixed_runtime.max_steps_role: high safety ceiling only; not a token or quality budget
fixed_runtime.tool_execution_timeout_role: quality-preserving safety ceiling for one validation command, not a cost budget

execution.logical_case_order: exact Golden-10 manifest order within each candidate
execution.schedule: serial interleaved command order: v4-pro shard-a, glm shard-a, v4-pro shard-b, glm shard-b, v4-pro shard-c, glm shard-c
execution.reason_for_serialization: avoid shared repository-cache and official evaluator resource races; candidate interleaving reduces subscription-quota and time-of-day confounding

capability_preflight.kind: outcome-blind two-call native tool round-trip transport probe
capability_preflight.allowed_model_calls: one probe per candidate before the Golden-10 denominator starts
must_match: one native tool call with exact schema arguments followed by a synthetic tool result and successful final response
non-empty provider response.model captured as the candidate's preflight observed-model identity
capability_preflight.formal_identity_rule: Every successful formal LLM call must retain the exact requested provider/model and report the same observed response.model identity frozen by that candidate's probe.
capability_preflight.failure_rule: A candidate whose requested identity, observed response.model identity, or native-tool contract cannot pass the frozen probe is invalid and may not enter formal selection.

valid_candidate: all successful LLM calls report the exact provider/model identity
all successful LLM calls report the candidate's preflight-bound observed response.model identity
candidate/prediction/official patch bytes align for every non-empty patch
official evaluator exits cleanly without structural warnings

selection_rule.primary: highest official_resolved over the fixed planned denominator of 10
tie_break_order: fewer provider or evaluator infrastructure failures
selection_rule.validity_requirement: both candidates must complete and remain protocol-valid
selection_rule.if_either_invalid: do not select a winner; repair infrastructure under a new preregistration

freeze_rule: Only the mechanically selected winner may be written to showcase-quality-v1 and used for Canonical-50. Canonical-50 outcomes cannot reopen this choice.
claim_limits: Golden-10 is a development set and does not measure general SWE-bench Verified performance.
This comparison chooses a current model/profile; it does not isolate Harness uplift.
Thinking mode omits transport temperature, so temperature=0 is recorded configuration rather than deterministic output.
GPT 5.6 Luna is excluded from this comparison because the current Harness transport is Chat-Completions native; adding Responses reasoning-item state would be a second experimental factor.
The 128-step ceiling is an emergency convergence guard, not a cost or token optimization; normal completion should be governed by final-answer and tool-loop stop conditions.
